prompt: Original Japanese top-down pixel RPG asset visually inspired by Pokemon FireRed's overworld. Orthographic three-quarter TOP-DOWN RPG angle, front facing directly down to player, no isometric diamond or perspective convergence. Chunky deliberate pixels, crisp edges, restrained 24-color palette, dark colored outlines, sun from upper left, simple 3-shade clusters. Transparent background, no floor, no shadow beyond footprint, no text or logos. Readable when scaled down into a 16px-grid game. Match the attached reference sprites exactly in palette, outline and pixel density. Match the palette, outline weight, pixel density and three-quarter top-down angle of the attached reference sprites exactly. Generate ONE character walk sheet for: friendly wagashi shopkeeper wearing a cream headscarf tied at the back, muted red shirt, cream shop apron over dark trousers and dark shoes. No backpack. Use attached player sheet as the exact layout, head/body proportion, pose and animation reference; buildings are palette references only. Exactly THREE columns and FOUR rows, twelve full-body poses. Rows DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, UP in this order. All three figures in LEFT row face LEFT; all three in RIGHT row face RIGHT. Columns idle feet together, step A, step B opposite leg and arm forward. Each frame 16x24 logical pixels, enlarged cleanly, same scale throughout. Feet bottom-centre. Flat chunky shading, no gradients. Truly transparent empty space, no backdrop or halos. No grid lines, labels or extra poses.
notes: Art export reviewed at 1x and 4x. Rows down,left,right,up; columns idle,stepA,stepB. Foot anchor is cell-local at lower edge. Loader/animation registration and manifest integration belong to issue #1. Source RGB may show glow when alpha is ignored; export uses hard alpha >=128 and canonical transparent RGB.

export.method: Threshold alpha at 128; find 4 occupied row bands and 3 occupied column bands per row; crop each frame to alpha content; preserve aspect ratio and nearest-neighbour fit within 14x22; centre horizontally and bottom-align in 16x24 cells; assemble 48x96 sheet; median-cut quantize to 23 RGB colors with dithering disabled; restore hard alpha and zero transparent RGB.
export.palette: Per-sheet median-cut from reference-matched generated art, <=23 opaque colors plus transparent.
